title: Market Failure Adventure 3: Common Pool Resources
welcome_lead: Today you'll explore the commons, Ostrom's principles and policy fixes.
meta_desc: Economics: common pool resources, tragedy of the commons, Ostrom's design principles.
final_note: You explained CPR failure and Ostrom's design principles for sustainable governance.

concepts.def: Legal entitlement to use a resource

walkthroughs.body_html:
Each fisher gains the full catch but bears only a share of the depletion cost.

Hardin (1968): without rules, individually rational behaviour drives a collective tragedy — overgrazing, overfishing, climate change.

Elinor Ostrom (1990) studied successful commons.

Eight principles include: clear boundaries, rules matched to local conditions, collective choice, monitoring, graduated sanctions, dispute resolution.

Government control isn't the only fix — bottom-up institutions work too.

Tools to manage CPRs:

- Quotas (EU CFP fishing).
- Property rights (ITQs in NZ).
- Cap-and-trade (EU ETS carbon market).
- Tax (Pigouvian carbon tax).
- Community management (Ostrom-style).
